newsitem.title: USA: First Montauk Q4 oper share net $0.05.
newsitem.headline: First Montauk Q4 oper share net $0.05.

text.p: First Montauk Financial Corp said on Thursday it will report a loss of $340,000, or $0.04 per share, on revenues of $9 million for the fourth quarter of 1996.
But operating earnings for the quarter were $720,000, or a per-share profit of $0.05.

For full-year 1996, Montauk expects to report a profit of $360,000, or $0.04 per share, on revenues of $36.1 million. But operating net revenues were $2.9 million, or $0.20 per share. For comparison, full-year 1995 revenues were $28.3 million.

Montauk said its results were hurt by one-time charges totaling $2.3 million, including $1.3 million in the fourth quarter, to settle securities claims arising from the actions of one of its former branch offices.
